bundled_era5.label: ERA5-Land monthly · Team series · land average 3–15°N, 33–48°E · 1985–2025
bundled_era5.notes: The team's rainfall series, the input of its R script: the plain average over the land cells of 3–15°N, 33–48°E in the ERA5-Land monthly product, June–September 1985–2025. An area that extends beyond Ethiopia, not one farm. In September 2022 and June–September 2023 the monthly product is 36–50% of the ERA5-Land hourly series at the two grid points compared; the series is used as supplied. SHA-256 verifies the bundled files, not a provider signature. Gamma trials are generated simulations, not observations.
